dup.zh: 这个邮箱已经在名单里了，发布时同样会通知你。
dup.en: That email is already on the list — you'll be told at launch too.

fail.zh: 提交没有成功，请稍后再试；也可以到页面底部的意见反馈直接告诉我们。
fail.en: That didn't go through. Please try again shortly, or reach us through the feedback link at the bottom of the page.

closed.zh: 收集通道尚未开通，这里还不能提交。想先聊聊，请用页面底部的意见反馈。
closed.en: The sign-up channel isn't open yet, so this form can't take submissions. To talk to us now, use the feedback link at the bottom of the page.
